verification.result: All seven bills signed and chaptered September 21, 2026: AB1577 chapter434; AB2383 chapter435; AB2469 chapter436; AB2619 chapter437; SB886 chapter438; SB887 chapter439; SB1168 chapter440. Enactment is distinguished from January 1, 2027 effectiveness and later implementation dates.

California Constitution Article IV §8(c)(1) supplies ordinary-statute effective-date rule; reviewed the seven chaptered acts and found no urgency clause. These September 21 ordinary statutes become effective January 1, 2027, with later specified duties separately stated.

Chaptered §25302.10 excludes electrical capacity below10 MW and specified public/research/utility facilities; reporting process and timing set by CEC; at least annual operator reports with monthly disaggregation unless otherwise specified; IEPR assessment begins2029. §65909.3 estimates energy/onsite generation/noise for local discretionary applications; customer energy data protected.

verification.topic: AB2469 and AB2619 distinct water triggers
verification.result: AB2469 has no MW threshold; applies to construction or peak-water-increasing expansion and discretionary/ministerial approvals. Scarcity-plan requirement specifically begins January1 2028. AB2619 includes all three defined facility classes including below2MW; initial-license estimates and renewals with prior-year water use differ from AB2469 development approvals.

No universal75MW cutoff in chaptered SB886. Definitions supplied by AB2383; generation tariff threshold chosen by implementing entity must be no greater than25MW. SB886 transmission-specific §945.3 applies to new agreements on/after January1 2027; tariff/rule deadline January1 2028. Generation exceptions cannot be generalized across every provision.

Chaptered act bars categorical exemptions for covered data-center development, with specified facility exceptions; leadership-project certification is a distinct conditional pathway. Hourly100% zero-carbon within five years (75% newly developed), four-hour storage, water-efficient/recycled or waterless cooling and community-benefit conditions apply to that pathway, not all operating facilities.
SB57 signed October11 2025, chapter647; effective January1 2026. CPUC may assess cost shifts and must submit any completed assessment by January1 2027; not an enactment of a new tariff.
AB93 verified in Governor's October11 2025 veto list. Linked veto-message PDF located but image text not extracted; the policy record makes no claim about detailed veto rationale.

Official status page has no chapter; last displayed action August29 2025 held under submission, with July7 2025 amended text. Excluded from current requirements. Earlier deleted model-energy language in struck-out text is not operative law.

Official Data Centers page verifies forecasting from utility applications, existing building-energy benchmarking and separate onsite thermal-generation jurisdiction. It explicitly states CEC does not permit data centers themselves; SPPE is not a blanket CEQA exemption.

OEHHA final CES5.0 page dated July1 2026 references final September18 2026 disadvantaged-community designation. FAQ/model pages confirm census-tract ranking and multiple pollution/vulnerability indicators; no project score generated.

DWR annual assessment page confirms supplier threshold, annual July1 timing, imported-water allocation exception, drought assumptions and ongoing reassessment. Separate current urban-efficiency page confirms five-year UWMP2025-cycle due July1 2026; only annual-assessment source included to limit bibliography.

September1 2026 official CARB bulletin identifies November10 2026 deadline and describes Initial Regulation as conditional on OAL approval. February press release's August10 date is stale. No later official approval verified in this search; policy preserves conditional implementation language.

Direct program, September1 guidance PDF and rulemaking webpage returned JavaScript/bot verification via web. Official CARB GovDelivery bulletin was accessible and used as primary evidence. Secondary legal/accounting pages were discovery leads only.

Official December1 2025 CARB bulletin says enforcement enjoined pending appeal, reports optional, and SB253 unaffected. No latest appellate disposition verified; SB261 not presented as an operative current requirement in policy cards.

Thirteen primary sources retained with parent approval to exceed initial ten-source cap modestly. Sources prioritize all seven enacted 2026 bills, existing facility context, 2025 precedent, water, screening and one carefully bounded corporate disclosure record. This is a targeted policy scan, not an exhaustive legal search.

limitations: No blanket environmental obligation inferred from AI transparency or AI-training-data laws.
No statutory reporting proposal, industry submission, forecast, or voluntary procurement recommendation relabeled as current law.
No facility-specific compliance opinion or measured environmental score generated.
Post-review legal or rulemaking changes require a dated refresh.
